bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-doc-24bade)" || exit 59
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 63249b632c61198f6a357564101da7b5da38361b || exit 63
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_link_video_caption_smoke.py)" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_video_caption_smoke.py)" || exit 64
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-mp4doc-e2e.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py >"$tmp/userbot_test_client.py"
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 65
if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_video_caption_smoke >"$tmp/out" 2>&1; then
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 67
 echo VIDEO_REGISTER_E2E=PASS
else
 reason="$(sed -n 's/^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=//p' "$tmp/out" | head -1)"
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 69
 case "$reason" in
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND_MENU*)exit 80;;
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND_VIDEO*)exit 81;;
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND_PAIR*)exit 82;;
  *SCREEN_NOT_FOUND_REGISTER*)exit 83;;
  *SENT_AS_DOCUMENT*)exit 84;;
  *UNCLASSIFIED_VIDEO*)exit 85;;
  *EXISTING_DRAFT_BLOCKED*)exit 86;;
  *)exit 87;;
 esac
fi
